item.title: parallelly 1.25.0: availableCores(omit=n) and, Finally, Built-in SSH Support for MS Windows 10 Users
item.description: A piece of an ice core - more pleasing to look at than yet another illustration of a CPU core (Image credit: Ludovic Brucker, NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center) parallelly 1.25.0 is on CRAN. It comes with two major improvements: You can now use availableCores(omit = n) to ask for all but n CPU cores makeClusterPSOCK() can finally use the built-in SSH client on MS Windows 10 to set up remote workers
